text:
Lena Ortiz: Short question: how should saved queries expose per-model quota hints in the card UI? Proposing a thin info line: "Quota: 14,120 tokens left (monthly); routing may use fallback when < 2,000".

Samir B.: That sounds good. Also surface a small progress bar (striped when near threshold). Keep text concise.

Talia W.: Telemetry ask: when a user clicks the saved query card to preview, emit savedquery.preview.clicked with sample flag. We need to distinguish user-initiated preview vs hover preview.

Lena Ortiz: Good point. Differentiate with field preview_mode: hover|click. Click should increase cache TTL to 60s for subsequent interactions.

ops-bot: quota-monitor emitted alert: route-112 nearing 90% of monthly tokens.

Samir B.: For accessibility: the quota progress bar should have an aria-label text: "Quota remaining: 14,120 tokens of 100,000 monthly".

Talia W.: Also capture model_alias and region in telemetry for post-hoc analysis.

Lena Ortiz: Owners: Samir add progress bar + tooltip, Talia add telemetry events and preview_mode, I'll update copy for Save modal.

Samir B.: Will do. PR by EOD.

Lena Ortiz: Thanks :smile:
